title: TikTok Shop Ads: How to Turn Them On, Set Them Up, and Research Competitors
summary: Learn how to turn on TikTok Shop Ads, choose between Seller Center and TikTok Ads Manager, and use the TikTok Shop Ads Library to build creative that converts.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### How do I start TikTok Shop ads?


You start TikTok Shop ads from one of two entry points: Seller Center or TikTok Ads Manager. Seller Center launches campaigns directly from your shop account, while Ads Manager gives you a full campaign-building workspace with objective, ad group, and format settings. Check that your shop is active, your products are eligible in the catalog, and the required account connections are in place before building a campaign.


### What is the difference between TikTok Shop Ads and regular TikTok ads?


TikTok Shop Ads connect paid placements directly to products in a TikTok Shop catalog, letting shoppers view product details and move toward purchase in the app. Regular TikTok ads promote a broader objective, such as traffic or awareness, without a product-linked shopping destination. Choose Shop Ads when product discovery and shopping actions are your goal.


### What formats are available for TikTok Shop Ads?


TikTok Shop Ads come in three formats: Product Shopping Ads, Video Shopping Ads, and LIVE Shopping Ads. Product Shopping Ads feature eligible catalog listings, Video Shopping Ads pair products with shoppable video creative, and LIVE Shopping Ads promote products during a live session. Match the format to the content you can support.


### Should I use Spark Ads or Shop Ads?


Spark Ads and Shop Ads describe different parts of a campaign, not competing options. Spark Ads use an existing TikTok post as ad creative, while a shopping campaign defines the product-linked format and destination. Eligible setups can combine both, using creator or brand video as creative inside a product-linked campaign. Confirm post authorization and product attachment before launch.


### Is it worth doing TikTok ads for my shop?


TikTok ads are worth running when your products, creative, and campaign setup are aligned, because shop-focused formats shorten the path from discovery to purchase. Plan from per-order economics before you spend: Reacher Runway models a 3, 6, 9, and 12 month launch forecast so you can validate margins and break-even ROAS before committing budget. Treat its output as a planning estimate, not measured performance.


### Why can't I see the TikTok Shop ads option in my account?


A missing TikTok Shop ads option usually comes down to permissions or account connections, not platform unavailability. Verify that your TikTok Shop is active, your ad account is accessible, Business Center linking is complete, and your account has showcase permission. Shop access alone does not guarantee every objective or product source is enabled, so confirm each dependency before assuming the option is unavailable.


### What should I check before publishing a TikTok Shop ad?


Before publishing, confirm that the product is active and accurately described in your catalog, the creative aligns with the product destination, and your budget and campaign settings are complete. Review the final ad preview to make sure the message, creative, and shopping destination all match. Then submit for review or publish according to the status shown in your setup flow.
